user.title: Template Forecast
user.description: Name and mode for the new forecast helper.

transform_source.title: Source entity
transform_source.description: Entity whose list attribute should be transformed.

state_template_info_generate.name: Available variables & example
state_template_info_generate.description:
Available: `forecast` – the already computed result list from the attribute template below (e.g. `forecast[0].value`).

Example:
```
{{ forecast[0].value }}
```

attribute_template_info_generate.name: Available variables & examples
attribute_template_info_generate.description:
Available: `index` (0-based step), `horizon` (total number of steps), `forecast_time` (datetime of this step, UTC).

Simple value:
```
{{ (10 + (20 - 10) * index / horizon) | round(2) }}
```

Object (sets multiple fields per forecast entry, e.g. a custom `time`):
```
{{ {"time": forecast_time.isoformat(), "value": 10 + index, "condition": "sunny"} }}
```

state_template_info_transform.name: Available variables & example
state_template_info_transform.description:
Available: `forecast` (already computed result list), `source` (state of the source entity), `source_forecast` (original list before the transformation).

Example:
```
{{ source }}
```

attribute_template_info_transform.name: Available variables & examples
attribute_template_info_transform.description:
Available: `index` (position in the source list), `item` (the complete original element from the source list), `value` (`item.value`, if present).

Simple value:
```
{{ value * 2 }}
```

Object (merges extra fields into the item, e.g. adds a condition alongside the doubled value):
```
{{ {"value": value * 2, "condition": "sunny"} }}
```
